Please update your gitconfig to use a name from the Aspeed CLA.
OK, I have updated my gitconfig.
Can we please do something to make this common with the original aspeed class.  There is no reason we should copy/paste an entire file.

It only overwrites the do_generate_static, do_generate_image_uboot_file and do_generate_static_norootfs functions. The major change is adding BOOTMCU_FW_BINARY image. The BOOTMCU requires compilation using ast2700-riscv-linux-gnu. Refer to 

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/73642/5/meta-aspeed/recipes-bsp/bootmcu/bootmcu-fw.inc#11

Do you have any suggestions for modifications?"

I have rewritten the image_types_phosphor_aspeed_g7.bbclass.
Use do_merge_uboot task to merge the bootmcu and u-boot image before
do_generate_static to ensure compatibility with image_types_phosphor.bbclass.

Please help review again. Thanks.
I'm not accepting an entirely new file for this.  Figure out how to refactor the existing `image_types_phosphor.bbclass`.

Hi Patrick, If want to refactor the existing image_types_phosphor.bbclass file, we need to handle the build dependencies. 
```
do_generate_static[depends] += "${@bb.utils.contains('MACHINE_FEATURES', 'ast-bootmcu', 'bootmcu-fw:do_deploy', '', d)}"
do_generate_static_tar[depends] += "${@bb.utils.contains('MACHINE_FEATURES', 'ast-bootmcu', 'bootmcu-fw:do_deploy', '', d)}"
do_generate_ext4_tar[depends] += "${@bb.utils.contains('MACHINE_FEATURES', 'ast-bootmcu', 'bootmcu-fw:do_deploy', '', d)}"
```

If we use image_types_phosphor_aspeed_g7.bbclass the bootmcu-fw will only execute when building the ast2700. 

I think separating it out would have less impact on other BMCs. What do you think?

What is "bootmcu-fw"?  That recipe doesn't exist.  It's hard to make a judgement call when I don't know where these recipes come from.

I would rather not have chip-specific bbclasses.  If there is a need for a bootloader, we should probably make a new firmware section for it and handle that generally.  Having a bootloader can be a MACHINE_FEATURE.  The particular bootloader can be a MACHINE_FEATURE.  But adding a new partition for a bootloader doesn't need to be its own bbclass.

It is a RISC-V MCU (BootMCU) used as the first stage bootloader. 

The bootmcu-fw recipes at another commit. 
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/73642/8
The "bootmcu-fw" will be renamed to "bootmcu-spl" and it use for AST2700 A0. However, for AST2700 A1 it will build from Zephyr RTOS. We have discussed this in a previous email.
https://lists.ozlabs.org/pipermail/openbmc/2024-August/035873.html
We are planning use "virtual/bootmcu" to decide to use "bootmcu-spl" or Zephyr image. Example:
```
PREFERRED_PROVIDER_virtual/bootmcu ?= "bootmcu-spl"
```

If you still believe that refactoring the existing image_types_phosphor.bbclass is necessary, I can make the changes for review.

I add the bootmcu firmware section to image_types_phosphor.bbclass.
Please help to review again. Thanks.

Hi Patrick,

Could you please review it again? 

Thanks.
Got any definition/documenation of all these new BOOTMCU specific variables ?

It is defined at https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/73642/12/meta-aspeed/conf/machine/evb-ast2700.conf#6.

```
BOOTMCU_FW_BINARY = "ast2700-ibex-spl.bin"
```

V14-V15: for AST2700 bootmcu multiconfig.

Related commit:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/73642/38..39
V18: Fix multiconfig build for emmc/ufs.
Where does this CALIPTRA stuff come from?  I see no examples of this.

It is prebuild image from fmc-imgtool.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/73642/46/meta-aspeed/recipes-aspeed/python/fmc-imgtool_git.bb
I see no place where this is defined, but I absolutely hate this name.  "BMC-U" "B-MCU" it is very confusing.  Just use "BOOTMCU".  Characters aren't that expensive.

It is from another commit.
